First release of **ArrHub** – one web dashboard for **Radarr, Sonarr, NZBGet, qBittorrent and Seerr**.

## Highlights
- **Overview** – status of every service, speeds, free space, health warnings, active downloads and upcoming releases
- **Downloads** – manage qBittorrent (4.x and 5.x) and NZBGet queues, Radarr/Sonarr queues with remove + blocklist
- **Requests (Seerr)** – approve, decline and delete requests (also works with Overseerr and Jellyseerr)
- **Calendar, History, Add** – upcoming movies/episodes, latest events, search and add movies/series
- **Settings in the UI** – URLs, API keys and passwords with *Test connection*, applied without a restart; secrets never reach the browser
- **Themes and dynamic backgrounds** – 9 themes + automatic, custom accent colour, Aurora, Starfield, Particle network, Waves, Poster wall and Library images
- **English and Croatian** – language picker in Settings → Appearance
- Zero dependencies, Node.js 18+

## Install

**Docker** (amd64, arm64)
```bash
docker run -d --name arrhub --restart unless-stopped \
  -p 8686:8686 -v arrhub-data:/app/data \
  ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.0.0
```

**Proxmox LXC** (run on the Proxmox host as root)
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/proxmox/arrhub-lxc.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

Then open `http://<ip>:8686` and configure your services in **⚙ Settings**.

> ⚠ If ArrHub is reachable outside your LAN, enable the login in Settings – the dashboard can delete and add content.
